# Getting help

## A problem with a market trade

If a trade went wrong (you paid and got no code, the code didn't work, the seller didn't confirm), tap «مشکل دارم» on the trade in the app. The team sees the trade and can look into it; a GitHub issue can't.

## A bug or an idea

Open an [issue](https://github.com/Nisatech-org/shining-app/issues/new/choose). Persian or English is fine. Please search the existing issues first.

## Questions about Samad

Your credit, a reservation that Samad refused, or your student account are matters for the university's food service, not for Shining. Shining shows what Samad returns.

## Security problems

Don't open an issue. See [SECURITY.md](SECURITY.md).

## Anything else

Email [shining@nisatech.org](mailto:shining@nisatech.org).
